source.title: Perry Road Baptist Church Food Pantry Patron Registration Form

questions.label: Email
questions.note: The form's own email box (Google's collect-email setting), shown above the questions.

questions.label: First Name
questions.note: Help text: the person listed here should be the head of household.

questions.label: Last Name
questions.note: Help text: the person listed here should be the head of household.

questions.label: Date of Birth of person listed above
questions.note: A plain text box on the page, not a date picker.

questions.label: Street Address
City, State and Zip code
questions.note: One box for city, state and ZIP together; no single saved field holds all three.

questions.label: County
questions.note: The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Phone number
Email
questions.note: The form's own Email question, a text box with email validation, separate from Google's email box.

questions.label: Veteran Status:
questions.note: Asked right after the head of household's own details, so it is about the applicant, not the whole household.

questions.label: Total number of people in your household
questions.note: The form validates this box as a whole number.

questions.label: Please specify any food allergies, special dietary needs or restrictions.
questions.note: Dietary needs.

questions.label: Are there other members in your household in addition to yourself?
questions.note: Yes exactly when the household has more than one person; no answer rule reads that from the household size.

questions.label: Household member #2: First and Last Name
questions.note: Another household member's name. Sections for members #2 to #8 repeat these questions; only #2 is kept here.

questions.label: Date of Birth of household member #2
questions.note: Another household member's birth date; not in the profile. Sections #3 to #8 repeat this question.

questions.label: Relationship of household member #2 to head of household
questions.note: Relationship of another member; not in the profile. Sections #3 to #8 repeat this question.

questions.label: Are there other members in your household in addition to those already listed?
questions.note: Depends on how many members are already listed; no answer rule reads that. Sections #3 to #7 repeat this question.

questions.label: Does your household have more than 8 members?
questions.note: Yes exactly when the household has 9 or more people; no answer rule compares the household size to a number. Asked at the end of section #8.

questions.label: What Race/Ethnicity does the Head of Household identify as?
questions.note: Race or ethnicity; not in the profile. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: How did you hear about us?
options: Food Pantries of the Capital District
questions.note: How they heard about the pantry. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Do you receive the following? (check all that apply)
questions.note: Benefits the household already gets; a check-all list, not one yes/no fact. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Do you need assistance with (check all that apply)
questions.note: Other help wanted; a check-all list, not one saved program choice.
